verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents sensitive-data tooling to redact or remove sensitive data for GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance, which covers part of the PII-scrubbing need. However, that tooling is explicitly retroactive, applied after events are stored, which is the opposite of the story's 'before sensitive payloads ever persist' requirement. missing for 10: server-side scrubbing rules applied at ingest, SDK-level filtering/redaction of keys before sending, any evidence of pre-persistence scrubbing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
